create_INCConfig: create an INCConfig instance for Intel Neural Compressor quantization with weight bits and group size
get_quant_method_layer: get the quantized linear method for a torch layer using INCConfig.get_quant_method
apply_gptq_quant_layer: apply GPTQ quantization to a layer with INCConfig backend selection
apply_awq_quant_layer: apply AWQ quantization to a layer with INCConfig backend selection
override_quantization_method: override auto-round quantization method to inc via INCConfig.override_quantization_method
